baselineActionEvidence.text: AQD V1 · Your closet, on your device
The complete private AQD app on one iPhone. Home · Closet · Planner · Agent · Profile. No account or app backend.
Add a piece → Build an outfit → Plan a date → Record wear
Outfits, themes, routines, trips, packing, wear history and local Agent. Same design foundation as V2.
Private by default, with clear limits

Local Profile, Settings and conversations stay on this device. Agent explains Apple Intelligence availability; manual closet and planning remain usable. Community, Inbox, accounts and sync are V2 extensions.
Device loss or app deletion can lose the closet. Export a local archive and restore it yourself. Exported files leave AQD only at your request; the system destination may use cloud storage.
